narrative.incident_description: Suspicious authentication activity detected on asset GOV-VPN-01 (hostname egov-vpn, sector govt). Four auth events were logged by sensor secrepo-sshd on 2014-12-02 between 04:14 and 04:17 UTC. No successful login or compromise has been confirmed.
recommended_next_actions: Confirm scope: verify the affected assets and whether the activity/exposure is real
Preserve relevant logs (CERT-In Directions require ICT system logs to be retained for 180 days)
Contain if confirmed: isolate the host per your incident response plan
Decide reportability now: if a listed incident type is confirmed, the 6-hour window applies
